lines.say: Part seven: sickle cell crises aur prevention.
Pichhla part ek line mein: sickle cell mein HbS, do hallmarks vaso-occlusion aur hemolysis, aur painful crisis mein rehydration aur pain control. Theek hai?
Ab sickle cell ki sabse khatarnak emergencies.
Topic twenty-three: acute chest syndrome.
Acute chest syndrome, ACS, kya hai? Sickle cell patient mein naya lung infiltrate, saath mein bukhar, chest pain, hypoxemia, wheezing, cough ya saans ki takleef.
Naya infiltrate, naya infiltrate: yahi definition ki chaabi hai.
Cause aksar ek se zyada hota hai: infection, lung ki vessels mein vaso-occlusion, kam saans lena, atelectasis, thrombosis, aur kabhi fat embolism.
Management step by step: oxygen, IV fluids, pain control, aur har patient ko broad-spectrum antibiotics, kyunki infection hamesha ho sakta hai. Ek baar aur: har patient ko antibiotics.
Par mainstay kya hai? Blood transfusion, kyunki naya khoon oxygen carrying badhaata hai, aur sickle cells ko dilute karta hai. Mainstay, transfusion.
Kitna transfusion, yeh severity par. Mild: saturation 90 percent se upar aur ek lobe, toh 0 se 2 unit simple transfusion.
Moderate: saturation 85 percent ya zyada aur 2 lobes tak, toh 2 se 3 unit.
Severe: saturation 85 percent se kam aur 2 se zyada lobes, toh exchange transfusion. Ek baar aur: severe, toh exchange transfusion.
Exchange transfusion ke aur indications: pehle severe ACS ya heart-lung disease, ek se zyada lobe, simple transfusion ke baad bhi badhna, aur oxygen badhane par bhi saturation girna.
File ka MCQ: bachcha, halki respiratory infection, phir bukhar aur saans ki takleef, X-ray par lobar infiltrate, Hb low aur reticulocytes high.
Low Hb aur high retic matlab hemolysis, aur naya infiltrate matlab acute chest syndrome.
Toh answer: sickle cell anemia, A. Answer: sickle cell anemia. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: ACS: naya infiltrate plus bukhar ya chest pain ya hypoxia. Sabko antibiotics; mainstay transfusion; severe ya multilobar mein exchange transfusion.
Topic twenty-four: aplastic crisis versus splenic sequestration.
Dono mein Hb achanak girta hai, toh farq kaise? Ek hi test: reticulocyte count. Retic, retic.
Aplastic crisis mein bone marrow kuch din ke liye naye red cells banana band kar deta hai. Isliye reticulocytes kam.
Sabse common cause? Parvovirus B19, jo red cell precursors ko maarta hai. Ek baar aur: parvovirus B19.
Splenic sequestration crisis mein marrow theek kaam kar raha hai, par red cells spleen mein phans kar jama ho jaate hain.
Hb baseline se 2 gram per dL ya zyada girta hai, spleen achanak bada ho jaata hai, aur reticulocytes high rehte hain. Yeh jaan-leva hai, kyunki khoon spleen mein chala gaya.
File ka MCQ: sickle cell patient, dono pairon mein 3 ghante se dard, DVT nahi, spleen bada, aur Hb 3.2.
Bada spleen plus bahut kam Hb: splenic sequestration.
Best next step? Blood transfusion, D. Answer: blood transfusion.
Hydration aur morphine painful crisis ke liye hain, par yahan jaan khoon ki kami se ja rahi hai. Ye point yaad rakhna hai.
Yaad rakhna hai: aplastic crisis: retic kam, parvovirus B19. Sequestration: retic high, spleen bada, Hb bahut kam, toh transfusion.
Topic twenty-five: complications se bachao.
Sickle cell mein spleen jaldi kaam karna band karta hai, toh capsulated bacteria se infection ka khatra.
Bachao kaise? Pneumococcal, meningococcal aur Hib vaccines, aur roz penicillin prophylaxis, kam se kam 5 saal ki umar tak. Ek baar aur: penicillin, 5 saal tak.
Aur complications kam karne ki dawa? Hydroxyurea.
Kaise kaam karti hai? Fetal hemoglobin, HbF, badhaati hai, aur HbF sickle nahi hota. Hydroxyurea, HbF. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: vaccines plus penicillin 5 saal tak. Hydroxyurea HbF badhaati hai.
Ek baar dobara dekhte hain: acute chest syndrome mein naya infiltrate; sabko antibiotics, mainstay transfusion, severe mein exchange.
Aplastic crisis mein retic kam aur parvovirus B19; sequestration mein retic high, spleen bada, aur transfusion.
Prevention ke liye vaccines, penicillin 5 saal tak, aur hydroxyurea, jo HbF badhaati hai.
Ab chhota sa quiz. Sawal suno, ruko, khud jawab socho, phir answer suno.
Sawal ek: acute chest syndrome ki definition ki chaabi?
Naya lung infiltrate. Naya infiltrate.
Sawal do: ACS mein kis patient ko antibiotics?
Har patient ko. Sabko antibiotics.
Sawal teen: ACS ka mainstay treatment?
Blood transfusion. Transfusion.
Sawal chaar: saturation 85 se kam aur 2 se zyada lobes?
Exchange transfusion. Exchange.
Sawal paanch: aplastic crisis aur sequestration mein farq karne wala test?
Reticulocyte count. Retic.
Sawal chhe: aplastic crisis ka sabse common cause?
Parvovirus B19. Parvovirus B19.
Sawal saat: bada spleen, Hb 3.2, retic high. Next step?
Blood transfusion. Transfusion.
Sawal aath: penicillin prophylaxis kab tak?
Kam se kam 5 saal ki umar tak. 5 saal.
Sawal nau: hydroxyurea kaise kaam karti hai?
HbF badhaati hai. Fetal hemoglobin.
